The institutional investor held 37,803 shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.31M, up from 30,167 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Rothschild Investment Corp who had been investing in Chevron Texaco Corp Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $237.23B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.81% or $1.02 during the last trading session, reaching $124.14. About 2.31 million shares traded. Chevron Corporation (NYSE:CVX) has risen 16.25% since May 31, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 3.68% the S&P500.
